note: 200-card base set (#1-200) mixing current stars, retired legends and a heavy rookie class; rookies carry the RC logo (59 RCs). Hits: Pristine Autographs (PA), Italics Autographs (I), Pristine Pair Dual Autographs (PDA), Personal Endorsements (PEA), Spotless Signatures (SS), Popular Demand (PDAR) and Pristine Pieces (PPAR) auto relics, and Rookie Jumbo Relic Autographs (RJRA); parallels (Aqua /199 through SuperFractor 1/1) are omitted. Inserts Amped, Monogram and Pearlescent are not included.
